## Welcome

This is the home page of ernybod.br website built with Quarto.

### About This Site

This site is built using [Quarto](https://quarto.org), an open-source scientific and technical publishing system.

### Getting Started

To build this site locally, you'll need to:

1. Install Quarto from [quarto.org](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/)
2. Run `quarto preview` to preview the site
3. Run `quarto render` to build the site

The rendered site will be in the `_site` directory.
